changes.network_monitor: One NSLock over one State {onChange, generation, active (fresh NWPathMonitor + TrailingDebouncer)}; existing serial queue. start(): check/bump generation/build/store active atomically under the lock, idempotent while active; monitor.start(queue:) outside the lock. stop(): take active, bump generation only if one was active, idempotent; debouncer.cancel and monitor.cancel outside the lock. Debouncer delivery captures [weak self]; deinit cancels the active monitor/debouncer. deliver(armedAs:) checks generation and reads onChange in one locked step, calls it outside. No API, factory, protocol, hook or setting.
changes.held_call: recordedExcept removed. Sticky takenOnCooperativePool asserted false in InteractiveHostHarness, AppStateHarness and DaemonHarness teardowns. Held calls are release tickets (issued/released): each release lets the oldest held call go; with nothing held it pre-releases the current arm; with nothing armed or held it is a no-op; a call taken without being held issues no ticket, so it never lets another arm's call go. Re-arming while held hands the hold on (see deviation).
changes.coalesce_witness: testACoalescedFlushWhoseHopWaitsForTheOwnerEmitsOnceAfterIt (non-discriminating) replaced by testAStaleCoalesceHopAfterAnImmediateEmitAndRearmFlushesNothingEarly: one GCD main block arms timer 1, queues the immediate-emit+re-arm block, then holds main 400 ms so timer 1's hop queues behind it; probe block queued after. Positive log witness [emit, held, emit, rearmed, probe] then exactly one more emit. Uses only existing seams and main-queue FIFO; parks main because main is the owner today (Stage B needs an owner-ordering witness instead).
changes.pm_sim: runtime-host-effects connection-audit exercise: path observer runs while the proxy runs; a Stop leaving every module down stops it; the next Start observes again; a FakeNetworkPathObserver report after the restart produces network.path_changed in events.ndjson.
